arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Spinelli explained that Section 365 lets the trustee decide on contract assumption.
Mr. Tripp argued that trademarks differ from other intellectual property rights.
Justice Sotomayor noted that Section 365(n) is not the default rule for IP.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests the scope of a bankruptcy trustee's power to reject executory contracts. The core conflict involves the interaction between bankruptcy law and intellectual property rights.
